description: A monophonic pitch track by PESTO (mir-1k_g7 checkpoint, pinned by digest) at a 10 ms step on 16 kHz mono: the pitch and PESTO's confidence. Meant for one voice, a vocal stem by --from stems/vocals. Runs under the operator's f0-python, so the archive's environment never imports PyTorch.

f0.description: one row every 160 samples at 16 kHz (10 ms), columns the pitch in Hz (0 where the tracker gives none) and PESTO's confidence, 0 to 1

rows_from_tracker.description: rows the tracker returned before the track was cut, or padded with zeros, to the grid: n // 160 + 1 rows for n samples
